audit.method: Read from the full term sheet by one AI reviewer, then checked against it twice by independent AI reviewers: first every line of the record against the document, then the document section by section against the record. Not signed off by a person. Every quote is looked up in the PDF text each time the tool runs.
audit.open_points:
Final record written to C:\Users\AFarid\Documents\Hackathon\key_credit_terms\data\audited\quaker_chemical_2026.json. Checker: structure OK, 89 of 89 quotes exact. A field-by-field diff against the first-audit record shows only the changes listed.

The document-to-record pass found no wrong, transposed or misattributed figure. Every amount, ratio, percentage and period in the record matches the dump, and the page images I opened (pp. 3, 5, 7, 13, 14, 16, 17, 19-22, 24, 29) show clean text with no strike-through and no existing/proposed columns. Barclays, equity cures, MFN, excess cash flow and reporting deadlines do not appear anywhere in the dump, so the not_stated and by_reference statuses stand.

First auditor's doubts resolved from the document:
- Doubt 1 (conditions_subsequent): by_reference kept; covenant (xii) on p.18 addresses post-closing deliverables and defers their terms.
- Doubt 2 (fc_other): the 3.50x secured test stays in the leverage row; it is limb (2) of the leverage bullet on p.22.
- Doubt 4 (guarantor_coverage): 'stated' kept; the 85% test is a real coverage test and the line says it is domestic-only.

What the document cannot resolve:
1. Whether the 0.50x acquisition step-up applies to the 3.50x secured test after a Financial Covenant Adjustment. The term sheet gives it for the Consolidated Net Leverage Ratio only; 4.75x is computed, not printed.
2. Whether Material Domestic Subsidiaries guarantee the Dutch Borrower's Euro Term Loan and RCF borrowings. It follows only indirectly, from the Company's joint and several liability (p.1) and 'guaranty of the Borrowers' obligations made by the Guarantors' (p.24).
3. Apparent drafting errors, recorded as printed: the decline right cites 'clause (a) or (c)' with no clause (c), so 'Excess cashflow: none listed' rests on the list as printed; two overlapping purchase money / capital lease baskets ($165m / 50% and $115m / 35%); and the reinstatement test 'as of the last of the two most recently ended fiscal quarters'.
4. Terms left to the Existing Credit Agreement, which was not consulted: Consolidated Funded Indebtedness, Consolidated Interest Coverage Ratio, Significant Subsidiaries, Permitted Post-Closing Reorganization, the change of control trigger and event of default grace periods.
5. Negative statements (no + 1 + 1, not springing, no cap on share repurchases or acquisitions, no MFN, no fall-away of guarantees) are absences in the document, not express terms.

Style points left as they were:
- About 39 printed lines exceed the 250-character house target (longest 348, all under the 420 limit); I did not rewrite lines for length alone.
- select_definitions has three 'Adjusted EBITDA: ' lines.
- The 0.50x / $75m step-up and the $25m sweep threshold appear a second time as short cross-references in Permitted Acquisitions and Permitted Disposals.
- doc.notes runs to five sentences because it carries the pricing grid; the brief for that field asks for two to four.
- The repayment instalment dates (p.12) are now supported by a page pointer in the note, not a quote, because of the three-quote limit.

doc.title: SUMMARY OF PRINCIPAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS - QUAKER CHEMICAL CORPORATION - $[1.55][1.6] BILLION SENIOR SECURED CREDIT FACILITIES
doc.notes: Posting-version term sheet for new senior secured credit facilities of Quaker Chemical Corporation (US Dollar Term Loan, Euro Term Loan, multicurrency RCF) that amend or amend and restate, and refinance, the Existing Credit Agreement dated 1 August 2019. Terms are on pages 1-27 in a label / value layout; Addendum I (pages 28-29) has pricing, fees and the pricing grid. It gives the new terms only (no existing-versus-proposed columns); the RCF size and total are bracketed alternatives ($[750][800]m; $[1.55][1.6]bn) and the opening margins and commitment fee are blank. It is qualified by the Facilities Documentation (covenant exceptions and baskets beyond those listed are to be agreed there) and takes undefined capitalised terms and event of default grace periods / materiality thresholds from the Existing Credit Agreement. Pricing has no template row: after the opening period (blank), a five-tier grid on the Consolidated Net Leverage Ratio (> 3.50x down to <= 1.25x) sets the Term SOFR / Alternative Currency margin and letter of credit fee at 1.750% to 1.000%, the Base Rate margin at 0.750% to 0.000% and the commitment fee at 0.275% to 0.125% (p.29); Term SOFR and the Alternative Currency rates are floored at 0% (p.28).
